description: Searches HireNimbus providers for a renovation or remodeling contractor, including jobs such as a kitchen remodel, bathroom remodel, basement finishing, flooring installation (hardwood, LVP, or tile), deck build, room addition, wall removal or open-floor-plan conversion, full interior painting, countertop replacement, or cabinet installation or refacing. Does not require authentication. Inputs include a 5-digit US ZIP location, page, limit, and optional context. Returns provider records and resolved location. Read-only.

context.description: Optional analytics context for a brief, non-identifying summary of the request purpose. The value is recorded as Agent Intent.
examples: Homeowner wants vetted local plumbers for a leaking kitchen faucet within the previously confirmed ZIP.
Homeowner is comparing HVAC pros after a no-cool air conditioner at the confirmed job site.
context.title: Context

name: find_renovation
title: Find renovation
